只传输声音，不传画面；本机没有声音播放时不产生流量。手机熄屏或切到其他应用时会继: Only sound is sent, no picture; nothing is sent while this machine plays nothing. Playback continues with the phone's screen off or another app in front; stop it from the lock screen or notifications
主数据库切换会写入本地配置并需要重启服务；运行中的连接不会被热替换。当前安全路线: Switching the primary database writes a local configuration override and requires a service restart; live connections are not hot-swapped. The safe path currently supports PostgreSQL.
主数据库配置已写入，请重启服务: Primary database configuration saved. Restart the service.
删除目标 PostgreSQL 的所有表并重新初始化后台: Drop all tables in the target PostgreSQL database and reinitialize the backend
此操作会删除目标数据库中的全部数据；请输入 REINITIALIZE DATAB: This deletes all data in the target database; enter REINITIALIZE DATABASE
Telegram 目标在系统设置的 backup.telegram_destin: Configure Telegram targets as JSON in backup.telegram_destinations; for restricted networks set proxy_enabled to true and proxy_url (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5) in http_client.runtime.
可选：telegram:目标ID、wecom、dingtalk 或 custom: Optional: telegram:target-id, wecom, dingtalk, or custom; separate multiple targets with commas or new lines
留空时备份当前项目数据库；选择已保存的连接后，将按该连接执行 PostgreSQ: Leave empty to back up the current project database; choose a saved connection to back up that PostgreSQL database.
黑名单优先于白名单: The blocklist takes precedence over the allowlist
白名单填写后只允许白名单中的 IP 或 CIDR 访问后台；黑名单命中后始终拒绝: When an allowlist is filled, only its IPs or CIDRs can access the admin console; a blocklist match is always denied. Leave either list empty to disable that restriction. The local machine can still repair an allowlist, but it is denied if its address is added to the blocklist.
每行填写一个 IP 或 CIDR，例如 203.0.113.8 或 192.16: Enter one IP or CIDR per line, for example 203.0.113.8 or 192.168.1.0/24
每行填写一个要拒绝的 IP 或 CIDR，黑名单优先级更高: Enter one IP or CIDR to deny per line; the blocklist has higher priority
留空表示允许所有 IP: Leave empty to allow every IP
留空表示不拒绝任何 IP: Leave empty to deny no IPs
黑白名单配置尚未完成数据库升级: The access-list database migration has not completed yet
配置应用服务启动时自动执行的系统命令: Configure system commands to run when the application service starts
命令会在本程序服务启动时执行一次。要随电脑开机运行，请先用 service in: The command runs once when this application's service starts. To run it at computer startup, install this application as a system service with service install; commands use the service account's permissions. Windows, Linux, and macOS are supported.
例如 Windows 使用 ipconfig，Linux/macOS 使用 ip: For example, use ipconfig on Windows, or ip addr / ifconfig on Linux and macOS
留空使用服务默认工作目录: Leave empty to use the service's default working directory
配置编辑器直接使用 Rathole 原生 TOML，支持服务端/客户端、TCP/: The editor uses native Rathole TOML and supports all upstream options, including server/client mode, TCP/UDP, TLS, Noise, WebSocket, proxies, IPv6, heartbeats, retries, and hot reload.
填写 socks5:// 或 http:// 地址，例如 socks5://us: Enter a socks5:// or http:// URL, for example socks5://user:password@127.0.0.1:1080. Leave empty for a direct connection.
客户端代理只影响客户端连接服务端的出站连接；控制流和映射数据会复用同一条已建立的: The client proxy applies to the client's outbound connection to the server. Control traffic and mapped data reuse the same established proxy tunnel, including the return direction.
Rathole 是反向代理内网穿透工具。公网服务器运行服务端，内网机器运行客户端: Rathole is a reverse proxy for NAT traversal. The public server runs the server role and the private machine runs the client role. The client connects outbound, and traffic arriving at a public server port is forwarded to a local service. It is useful for private websites, remote desktop, SSH, NAS, cameras, and development environments.
先在公网机器创建“服务端”配置，再在内网机器创建“客户端”配置。两边的 remo: Create a server profile on the public machine first, then a client profile on the private machine. The remote address, service names, and tokens must match. The server bind_addr is the public listener; the client local_addr points to the private service.
顶层运行模式。server 负责公网监听和端口映射，client 负责连接服务端: Top-level run mode. The server listens publicly and exposes mappings; the client connects to the server and forwards local services. A profile normally contains only one top-level section; Auto requires exactly one of them.
tcp 最简单；tls 用于证书加密；noise 使用 Noise 密钥协商；w: TCP is the simplest option; TLS adds certificate encryption; Noise uses Noise key exchange; WebSocket is useful in networks that require WebSocket traffic.
每个服务是一个映射，名称必须在服务端和客户端一致。type 可填 tcp 或 u: Each service is a mapping and its name must match on the server and client. type can be tcp or udp; the server uses bind_addr to expose a port and the client uses local_addr to target the private service.
用于服务端和客户端认证。建议修改默认值，并为不同服务使用独立 token。: Used to authenticate the server and client. Change the default value and use separate tokens for different services.
heartbeat_interval、heartbeat_timeout 用于检: heartbeat_interval and heartbeat_timeout detect connection health; retry_interval controls client reconnects. Increase the timeout values when the network is unstable.
可填 socks5:// 或 http:// 代理地址，适合客户端只能通过代理访: Use a socks5:// or http:// proxy when the client can reach the public network only through a proxy.
跨境或 IP 被封禁的场景：如果中国内网客户端无法直接连接美国服务端，在“客户端: For cross-border or blocked-IP scenarios: if a private client in China cannot connect directly to a US server, enter a working SOCKS5/HTTP proxy under Client outbound proxy, such as socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Saving writes proxy under [client.transport.tcp]. Configure it only on the client; once Rathole connects, control traffic, TCP/UDP mappings, and return traffic reuse the proxy tunnel.
Private website: expose 8080 on the server and point client local_addr to 127.0.0.1:8080. SSH/RDP: keep the service type tcp and point local_addr to 22 or 3389. UDP service: set type to udp on both sides. Multiple private machines: create one profile per client or add multiple services to one client profile.
不要把 change-me 留在生产环境；TLS 服务器需要 pkcs12 和: Do not keep change-me in production. A TLS server needs pkcs12 and pkcs12_password; Noise requires the client's local_private_key to match the server's remote_public_key. If startup fails, validate the profile and check addresses, ports, tokens, service names, and firewalls. Open the bind_addr port on the public server. Rathole hot-reloads file changes, so active connections may briefly reconnect.
